title: Bugs Bunny and Looney Tunes
description: A large central Bugs Bunny crouches dynamically with clenched fists and a wide grin, surrounded by smaller Looney Tunes characters including Daffy Duck, Tweety, Sylvester, Porky Pig, and others in playful poses. The vibrant composition features colorful brushstrokes, floating balls, and a bright background with dramatic lighting.
